description.narrative: Building on the UK-Mauritius Strategic Partnership Framework, the UK is committed to work together with Mauritius to enhance its position as an attractive investment destination for UK businesses. The project and its main deliverable, the UK-Mauritius Investment Sentiment Report, will provide comprehensive insights to develop mechanisms for delivering growth for UK-Mauritius investor relations, building an evidence-based understanding of how UK investors perceive the UK-Mauritius investment relationship, contributing to the overarching goals of the UK-Mauritius Strategic Partnership Framework under the Section 6 on Growth Trade and Investment. The project provides an evidence-based assessment of UK investor perceptions, confidence, and investment intentions towards Mauritius, alongside a sector-specific UK buyer sentiment deep dive to assess trade and sourcing dynamics in one priority sector.
